g.text: GoF implementation issue 4 (skin versus guts) — both patterns, doing different jobs
It is wrapped, and it knows nothing
about borders or styles. A test asserts
that it names no type from this package.
A fourth style edits draw() and the
enum — and retests the other three.
A fourth style is a new class; nothing
in this one changes. That is the guts
Decorator and Strategy are not alternatives here — they are stacked.
Decorator adds a responsibility to an object that was never designed
for it. Strategy varies one decision inside an object that was.
GoF, p. 180: Strategy is the better answer "where the Component class
is intrinsically heavyweight", because a decorator pays for the whole
Component interface and a strategy pays only for the hook.
